title: SquashFS signature (sqsh / hsqs)
summary: SquashFS is a read-only compressed filesystem used in Live CDs, embedded systems, and container images. The superblock begins with a 4-byte magic: 'sqsh' (0x73717368, little-endian) or 'hsqs' (0x68737173, big-endian, for big-endian systems).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Superblock: magic (4), inode_count (4), mod_time (4), block_size (4), frag_count (4), compressor (2), block_log (2), flags (2), id_count (2), version_major (2), version_minor (2), root_inode (8), bytes_used (8), ... .
Common compressors: gzip, lzma, lzo, xz, zstd.
SquashFS is the base layer format for many container images (Docker/OCI uses overlayfs on top of squashfs or ext4).
